verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ τὸ Ἀρνίον ἑστὸς ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος Σιών καὶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν τεσσεράκοντα τέσσαρες χιλιάδες ἔχουσαι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Πατρὸς αὐτοῦ γεγραμμένον ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai eidon kai idou to Arnion hestos epi to oros Siōn kai met’ autou hekaton tesserakonta tessares chiliades echousai to onoma autou kai to onoma tou Patros autou gegrammenon epi tōn metōpōn autōn
verses.literal: Then I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion and with Him 144,000 . . . . . . . . . who had His name and His Father’s name written on their foreheads
verses.literalPt: E OLHEI, e eis que estava o Cordeiro sobre o monte Sião, e com ele cento e quarenta e quatro mil, que em suas testas tinham escrito o nome de seu Pai.

verses.original: καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὡς φωνὴν ὑδάτων πολλῶν καὶ ὡς φωνὴν βροντῆς μεγάλης καὶ ἡ φωνὴ ἣν ἤκουσα ὡς κιθαρῳδῶν κιθαριζόντων ἐν ταῖς κιθάραις αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ēkousa phōnēn ek tou ouranou hōs phōnēn hydatōn pollōn kai hōs phōnēn brontēs megalēs kai hē phōnē hēn ēkousa hōs kitharōdōn kitharizontōn en tais kitharais autōn
verses.literal: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and the loud rumbling of thunder And the sound I heard was like harpists strumming their harps
verses.literalPt: E ouvi uma voz do céu, como a voz de muitas águas, e como a voz de um grande trovão; e ouvi uma voz de harpistas, que tocavam com as suas harpas.

verses.original: Καὶ ᾄδουσιν ὡς ᾠδὴν καινὴν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου καὶ ἐνώπιον τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο μαθεῖν τὴν ᾠδὴν εἰ μὴ αἱ ἑκατὸν τεσσεράκοντα τέσσαρες χιλιάδες οἱ ἠγορασμένοι ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai adousin hōs ōdēn kainēn enōpion tou thronou kai enōpion tōn tessarōn zōōn kai tōn presbyterōn kai oudeis edynato mathein tēn ōdēn ei mē hai hekaton tesserakonta tessares chiliades hoi ēgorasmenoi apo tēs gēs
verses.literal: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders And no one could learn the song except . . . the 144,000 . . . . . . . . . who had been redeemed from the earth
verses.literalPt: E cantavam um como cântico novo diante do trono, e diante dos quatro animais e dos anciãos; e ninguém podia aprender aquele cântico, senão os cento e quarenta e quatro mil que foram comprados da terra.

verses.original: οὗτοί εἰσιν οἳ μετὰ γυναικῶν οὐκ ἐμολύνθησαν παρθένοι γάρ εἰσιν οὗτοι οἱ ἀκολουθοῦντες τῷ Ἀρνίῳ ὅπου ἂν ὑπάγῃ οὗτοι ἠγοράσθησαν ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἀπαρχὴ τῷ Θεῷ καὶ τῷ Ἀρνίῳ
verses.transliteration: houtoi eisin hoi meta gynaikōn ouk emolynthēsan parthenoi gar eisin houtoi hoi akolouthountes tō Arniō hopou an hypagē houtoi ēgorasthēsan apo tōn anthrōpōn aparchē tō Theō kai tō Arniō
verses.literal: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women for they are virgins They follow the Lamb wherever He goes They have been redeemed from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb
verses.literalPt: Estes são os que não estão contaminados com mulheres; porque são virgens. Estes são os que seguem o Cordeiro para onde quer que vá. Estes são os que dentre os homens foram comprados como primícias para Deus e para o Cordeiro.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν οὐχ εὑρέθη ψεῦδος ἄμωμοί εἰσιν
verses.transliteration: kai en tō stomati autōn ouch heurethē pseudos amōmoi eisin
verses.literal: And no lie was found in their mouths they are blameless
verses.literalPt: E na sua boca não se achou engano; porque são irrepreensíveis diante do trono de Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἄλλον ἄγγελον πετόμενον ἐν μεσουρανήματι ἔχοντα εὐαγγέλιον αἰώνιον εὐαγγελίσαι ἐπὶ τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶν ἔθνος καὶ φυλὴν καὶ γλῶσσαν καὶ λαόν
verses.transliteration: Kai eidon allon angelon petomenon en mesouranēmati echonta euangelion aiōnion euangelisai epi tous kathēmenous epi tēs gēs kai epi pan ethnos kai phylēn kai glōssan kai laon
verses.literal: Then I saw another angel flying overhead with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth to every nation and tribe and tongue and people
verses.literalPt: E vi outro anjo voar pelo meio do céu, e tinha o evangelho eterno, para o proclamar aos que habitam sobre a terra, e a toda a nação, e tribo, e língua, e povo,

verses.original: λέγων ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Φοβήθητε τὸν Θεὸν καὶ δότε αὐτῷ δόξαν ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα τῆς κρίσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ προσκυνήσατε τῷ ποιήσαντι τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ θάλασσαν καὶ πηγὰς ὑδάτων
verses.transliteration: legōn en phōnē megalē Phobēthēte ton Theon kai dote autō doxan hoti ēlthen hē hōra tēs kriseōs autou kai proskynēsate tō poiēsanti ton ouranon kai tēn gēn kai thalassan kai pēgas hydatōn
verses.literal: And he said in a loud voice Fear God and give Him glory because the hour of His judgment has come Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters
verses.literalPt: Dizendo com grande voz: Temei a Deus, e dai-lhe glória; porque é vinda a hora do seu juízo. E adorai aquele que fez o céu, e a terra, e o mar, e as fontes das águas.

verses.original: Καὶ ἄλλος ἄγγελος δεύτερος ἠκολούθησεν λέγων Ἔπεσεν ἔπεσεν Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη ἣ ἐκ τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς πεπότικεν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη
verses.transliteration: Kai allos angelos deuteros ēkolouthēsen legōn Epesen epesen Babylōn hē megalē hē ek tou oinou tou thymou tēs porneias autēs pepotiken panta ta ethnē
verses.literal: Then a second angel followed saying Fallen fallen is Babylon the great who has made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality
verses.literalPt: E outro anjo seguiu, dizendo: Caiu, caiu Babilônia, aquela grande cidade, que a todas as nações deu a beber do vinho da ira da sua prostituição.

verses.original: Καὶ ἄλλος ἄγγελος τρίτος ἠκολούθησεν αὐτοῖς λέγων ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Εἴ τις προσκυνεῖ τὸ θηρίον καὶ τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτοῦ καὶ λαμβάνει χάραγμα ἐπὶ τοῦ μετώπου αὐτοῦ ἢ ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai allos angelos tritos ēkolouthēsen autois legōn en phōnē megalē Ei tis proskynei to thērion kai tēn eikona autou kai lambanei charagma epi tou metōpou autou ē epi tēn cheira autou
verses.literal: And a third angel followed them calling out in a loud voice If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand
verses.literalPt: E seguiu-os o terceiro anjo, dizendo com grande voz: Se alguém adorar a besta, e a sua imagem, e receber o sinal na sua testa, ou na sua mão,

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς πίεται ἐκ τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ θυμοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ κεκερασμένου ἀκράτου ἐν τῷ ποτηρίῳ τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ βασανισθήσεται ἐν πυρὶ καὶ θείῳ ἐνώπιον ἀγγέλων ἁγίων καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Ἀρνίου
verses.transliteration: kai autos pietai ek tou oinou tou thymou tou Theou tou kekerasmenou akratou en tō potēriō tēs orgēs autou kai basanisthēsetai en pyri kai theiō enōpion angelōn hagiōn kai enōpion tou Arniou
verses.literal: he too will drink the wine of God’s anger poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath And he will be tormented in fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb
verses.literalPt: Também este beberá do vinho da ira de Deus, que se deitou, não misturado, no cálice da sua ira; e será atormentado com fogo e enxofre diante dos santos anjos e diante do Cordeiro.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ καπνὸς τοῦ βασανισμοῦ αὐτῶν εἰς αἰῶνας αἰώνων ἀναβαίνει καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἀνάπαυσιν ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός οἱ προσκυνοῦντες τὸ θηρίον καὶ τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτοῦ καὶ εἴ τις λαμβάνει τὸ χάραγμα τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ho kapnos tou basanismou autōn eis aiōnas aiōnōn anabainei kai ouk echousin anapausin hēmeras kai nyktos hoi proskynountes to thērion kai tēn eikona autou kai ei tis lambanei to charagma tou onomatos autou
verses.literal: And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever Day and night there is no rest for those who worship the beast and its image or for anyone who receives the mark of its name
verses.literalPt: E a fumaça do seu tormento sobe para todo o sempre; e não têm repouso nem de dia nem de noite os que adoram a besta e a sua imagem, e aquele que receber o sinal do seu nome.

verses.original: Ὧδε ἡ ὑπομονὴ τῶν ἁγίων ἐστίν οἱ τηροῦντες τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὴν πίστιν Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hōde hē hypomonē tōn hagiōn estin hoi tērountes tas entolas tou Theou kai tēn pistin Iēsou
verses.literal: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus
verses.literalPt: Aqui está a paciência dos santos; aqui estão os que guardam os mandamentos de Deus e a fé em Jesus.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤκουσα φωνῆς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ λεγούσης Γράψον Μακάριοι οἱ νεκροὶ οἱ ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀποθνῄσκοντες ἀπ’ ἄρτι Ναί λέγει τὸ Πνεῦμα Ἵνα ἀναπαήσονται ἐκ τῶν κόπων αὐτῶν τὰ γὰρ ἔργα αὐτῶν ἀκολουθεῖ μετ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai ēkousa phōnēs ek tou ouranou legousēs Grapson Makarioi hoi nekroi hoi en Kyriō apothnēskontes ap’ arti Nai legei to Pneuma Hina anapaēsontai ek tōn kopōn autōn ta gar erga autōn akolouthei met’ autōn
verses.literal: And I heard a voice from heaven telling me to write Blessed are the dead those who die in the Lord from this moment on Yes says the Spirit they will rest from their labors for their deeds will follow them
verses.literalPt: E ouvi uma voz do céu, que me dizia: Escreve: Bem-aventurados os mortos que desde agora morrem no Senhor. Sim, diz o Espírito, para que descansem dos seus trabalhos, e as suas obras os seguem.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ νεφέλη λευκή καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν νεφέλην καθήμενον ὅμοιον υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου ἔχων ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ στέφανον χρυσοῦν καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ δρέπανον ὀξύ
verses.transliteration: Kai eidon kai idou nephelē leukē kai epi tēn nephelēn kathēmenon homoion huion anthrōpou echōn epi tēs kephalēs autou stephanon chrysoun kai en tē cheiri autou drepanon oxy
verses.literal: And I looked and saw a white cloud and seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand
verses.literalPt: E olhei, e eis uma nuvem branca, e assentado sobre a nuvem um semelhante ao Filho do homem, que tinha sobre a sua cabeça uma coroa de ouro, e na sua mão uma foice aguda.

verses.original: Καὶ ἄλλος ἄγγελος ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ κράζων ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῆς νεφέλης Πέμψον τὸ δρέπανόν σου καὶ θέρισον ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα θερίσαι ὅτι ἐξηράνθη ὁ θερισμὸς τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai allos angelos exēlthen ek tou naou krazōn en phōnē megalē tō kathēmenō epi tēs nephelēs Pempson to drepanon sou kai therison hoti ēlthen hē hōra therisai hoti exēranthē ho therismos tēs gēs
verses.literal: Then another angel came out of the temple crying out in a loud voice to the One seated on the cloud Swing Your sickle and reap because the time has come to harvest for the crop of the earth is ripe
verses.literalPt: E outro anjo saiu do templo, clamando com grande voz ao que estava assentado sobre a nuvem: Lança a tua foice, e sega; a hora de segar te é vinda, porque já a seara da terra está madura.

verses.original: καὶ ἔβαλεν ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῆς νεφέλης τὸ δρέπανον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐθερίσθη ἡ γῆ
verses.transliteration: kai ebalen ho kathēmenos epi tēs nephelēs to drepanon autou epi tēn gēn kai etheristhē hē gē
verses.literal: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth and the earth was harvested
verses.literalPt: E aquele que estava assentado sobre a nuvem meteu a sua foice à terra, e a terra foi segada.

verses.original: Καὶ ἄλλος ἄγγελος ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ τοῦ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἔχων καὶ αὐτὸς δρέπανον ὀξύ
verses.transliteration: Kai allos angelos exēlthen ek tou naou tou en tō ouranō echōn kai autos drepanon oxy
verses.literal: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven and he too had a sharp sickle
verses.literalPt: E saiu do templo, que está no céu, outro anjo, o qual também tinha uma foice aguda.

verses.original: Καὶ ἄλλος ἄγγελος ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ὁ ἔχων ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τοῦ πυρός καὶ ἐφώνησεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ τῷ ἔχοντι τὸ δρέπανον τὸ ὀξὺ λέγων Πέμψον σου τὸ δρέπανον τὸ ὀξὺ καὶ τρύγησον τοὺς βότρυας τῆς ἀμπέλου τῆς γῆς ὅτι ἤκμασαν αἱ σταφυλαὶ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai allos angelos exēlthen ek tou thysiastēriou ho echōn exousian epi tou pyros kai ephōnēsen phōnē megalē tō echonti to drepanon to oxy legōn Pempson sou to drepanon to oxy kai trygēson tous botryas tēs ampelou tēs gēs hoti ēkmasan hai staphylai autēs
verses.literal: Still another angel with authority over the fire came from the altar and called out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle Swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth because its grapes are ripe
verses.literalPt: E saiu do altar outro anjo, que tinha poder sobre o fogo, e clamou com grande voz ao que tinha a foice aguda, dizendo: Lança a tua foice aguda, e vindima os cachos da vinha da terra, porque já as suas uvas estão maduras.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔβαλεν ὁ ἄγγελος τὸ δρέπανον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐτρύγησεν τὴν ἄμπελον τῆς γῆς καὶ ἔβαλεν εἰς τὴν ληνὸν τοῦ θυμοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸν μέγαν
verses.transliteration: Kai ebalen ho angelos to drepanon autou eis tēn gēn kai etrygēsen tēn ampelon tēs gēs kai ebalen eis tēn lēnon tou thymou tou Theou ton megan
verses.literal: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath
verses.literalPt: E o anjo lançou a sua foice à terra e vindimou as uvas da vinha da terra, e atirou-as no grande lagar da ira de Deus.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπατήθη ἡ ληνὸς ἔξωθεν τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐξῆλθεν αἷμα ἐκ τῆς ληνοῦ ἄχρι τῶν χαλινῶν τῶν ἵππων ἀπὸ σταδίων χιλίων ἑξακοσίων
verses.transliteration: kai epatēthē hē lēnos exōthen tēs poleōs kai exēlthen haima ek tēs lēnou achri tōn chalinōn tōn hippōn apo stadiōn chiliōn hexakosiōn
verses.literal: And the winepress was trodden outside the city and the blood that flowed from it rose as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1,600 . . . stadia
verses.literalPt: E o lagar foi pisado fora da cidade, e saiu sangue do lagar até aos freios dos cavalos, pelo espaço de mil e seiscentos estádios.
